name: keon-algorithms-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is keon/algorithms, a collection of minimal, self-contained Python implementations of
classic data structures and algorithms. Each module documents its functions and classes with docstrings: what they
compute, their arguments and return values, worked examples and complexity notes.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The code under repair is the graph package algorithms/graph/ and the dynamic programming package
algorithms/dynamic_programming/.
The documentation in scope is: README.md and the module, class and function docstrings of the modules in
algorithms/graph/ and algorithms/dynamic_programming/.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is that page and those
docstrings; in-package code comments are only supporting evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the
documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Python 3.12 with pytest and has no network access; the algorithms package is imported from
`/workdir`. Keep the public API stable and keep every behavior that already matches its documentation working
exactly as it does now.
